prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: subtle decorative background texture for the Living Earth satellite web app
Primary request: Create one restrained, photorealistic-looking natural star field in a 1536x1024 landscape frame, designed to sit quietly behind a functional globe and interface.
Scene/backdrop: Near-uniform deep dark navy background, approximately #0B1220, with ample uninterrupted dark negative space.
Subject: Sparse, irregularly scattered pinpoint stars. The overwhelming majority are extremely tiny, faint points, with realistic variation in apparent brightness and only a few brighter points. Stars are subtly varied icy white and blue, with occasional warm white points.
Style/medium: Realistic astronomical photographic appearance, elegant and understated, with clean low-detail background for efficient image compression. Decorative natural sky texture, not an astronomically accurate map.
Lighting/mood: Quiet orbital dawn mood. Restrained overall brightness and contrast. Soft, very small optical falloff only around the few brightest stars, without giant glows.
Composition/framing: A sparse random distribution across the full frame, plenty of dark negative space, no dominant focal point, no dense band, no regular pattern.
Constraints: Generate exactly one image. Opaque background. No text, borders, watermarks, or interface elements.
Avoid: Galaxies, nebulae, Milky Way bands, planets, Earth, moon, satellites, drawn constellation lines, lens flares, diffraction crosses, star icons, evenly spaced dots, obvious noise or grain, large luminous blobs, dramatic space-art gradients.
scope: Decorative generated texture, not an astronomically mapped sky.
